text:
ci-bot: CI perf alert: microbench `kv_warmup_throughput` +7.3% regression on PR #21041 vs baseline (threshold +5%). CI link: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/98765

ci-bot: Diff summary:
```
benchmark: kv_warmup_throughput
baseline: 12450 ops/s
pr:       11550 ops/s
delta:    -7.2% (fail, threshold -5%)
profile:  /artifacts/98765/kv_warmup/trace.pb
```

alex: ugh, that's over threshold. PR 21041 touched kernel_selector + batcher path, likely related. starting a local repro now.

maria: I can repro on an m60 unit. command I used:
```bash
./tools/microbench --bench=kv_warmup_throughput --runs=30 --cpus=8 --quant=bf16 --commit=pr/21041
```

maria: got consistent ~11500 ops/s, same as CI. flamegraph shows hot in kernel_selector::score_candidate (samples ~28%).

sanjay: rough stack from perf top (sampling):
```
28% kernel_selector::score_candidate()
12% batcher::select_path()
9% kv_cache::lookup()
6% allocator::alloc_block()
```

alex: interesting, score_candidate doing more work now — PR added a new heuristic that checks seqlen distrib which may be O(n) over sample buffer instead of O(1).

jen: can you paste the changed snippet? I remember a loop over recent_samples that might be the culprit.

alex: snippet from PR diff:
```cpp
// PR21041: compute median seqlen over recent_samples
int median = 0;
for (auto &s : recent_samples) median_list.push_back(s.len);
s::sort(median_list.begin(), median_list.end());
median = median_list[median_list.size()/2];
// used inside kernel scoring path
```

maria: yep that's it — allocating vector + sorting per call inside hot path. We should not do that inside scorer; we can maintain running histogram or use reservoir summary.

sanjay: quick mitigation: make PR compute summary lazily and cache per-request for 1s, or move heavy compute to background aggregator. But for immediate unblock, recommend revert.

alex: agree. This is causing measurable CPU work per request. I'll file a revert PR to unblock the rollout.

jen: can we add a perf unit test to catch this pattern? maybe assert scorer path < X cycles for common seqlen distrib.

maria: I'll add a microbench that exercises score_candidate with varied recent_samples sizes and add gating threshold.

release-manager: plan: revert PR21041 (hotfix), then follow-up change with optimized summary and unit + microbench. Revert PR will be pushed in ~10m.

alex: created revert: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/21042 — triggering CI now.

ci-bot: revert PR21042 started CI run 98766. I'll post results. :robot_face:

jen: once revert green, let's roll the original PR into a feature branch and iterate. No rollout until perf signoff. :thumbsup:

maria: added issue tracking optimization: https://issues.redwood.example/ISSUE-4212 — assigning to sanjay

sanjay: taking it, will prototype histogram-based summary this afternoon.

alex: thanks all. moving to monitor CI.
